title: Why the Cloud Transforms Business

header.html: 1.1 Explain why and how the cloud is revolutionizing businesses: define cloud, agentic AI, infrastructure, digital transformation, open source and open standard; explain the benefits of cloud technology to digital transformation; describe the drivers and challenges of digital transformation; recognize Google Cloud's top differentiators
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

toc.title: Drivers and challenges of digital transformation

html:
1Key terms

Term Meaning
Cloud Computing resources delivered over the internet and paid for by use
Infrastructure The servers, storage and networks that run applications
Digital transformation Using digital technology to change how a business works and serves customers, not only moving old systems
Agentic AI AI agents that reason, plan and take actions toward a goal with limited human steps
Open source Software whose code is public and can be used and changed by anyone
Open standard A public specification that different products can follow to work together
Exam tip

. Digital transformation is a business change, not just a technology move. The cloud is a tool for it.

2Benefits of cloud technology

Benefit What it means
Scalability Grow or shrink resources to match demand
Cost-effectiveness Pay for what you use; no large upfront hardware purchase
Agility and speed Launch new products and tests in days, not months
Flexibility Choose the right tools and change them
Enhanced security Provider-scale security and built-in controls
Global reach and high availability Serve users close to where they are, with resilient services
Data-driven insights Analytics and AI on all of your data
Strategic value and focus Staff spend time on the business, not on running data centers

3Drivers and challenges of digital transformation

Drivers (why change) Challenges (what blocks it)
Customer expectations for digital, fast service Legacy systems that are hard to change
Competition from digital-first companies Skills gaps and cultural resistance
Cost pressure and need for efficiency Security, privacy and compliance concerns
New data and AI opportunities Data silos and poor data quality
Need to scale and enter new markets Budget and unclear business case

Not adopting new technology carries risks: falling behind competitors, higher costs, slower response, security exposure from old systems and losing talent and customers.

Exam tip

. Legacy systems, skills and culture are the classic challenges. Customer expectations and competition are the classic drivers.

4What makes Google Cloud different

Differentiator Meaning
World-leading AI AI research and Gemini models built into the products
Openness and interoperability Open source and open standards; multicloud and hybrid choices; no lock-in
AI Hypercomputer Purpose-built AI infrastructure for training and serving AI
AI-ready data platform BigQuery and other data products that connect data to AI
Security Secure by design with defense in depth
Global network Google's own network that carries Google services worldwide
Exam tip

. Openness means choice: open source, open standards and the ability to run in more than one cloud. It is how Google Cloud answers vendor lock-in.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A bank uses the cloud mainly to launch new customer features faster than its competitors. Which benefit of cloud technology does this show?

  • ALower upfront hardware cost
  • BPhysical security of the building
  • CReduced software license fees
  • DAgility and speed to market
Show the answer

Answer: D. Launching new products quickly is the agility and speed benefit.

S2A company moves its servers to the cloud but changes nothing about how it works or serves customers. Which statement is correct?

  • AThis is a full digital transformation of the business
  • BThis is agentic AI because all of the servers are brand new
  • CThis only moves technology, so transformation is limited
  • DThis is an open standard because the cloud is public
Show the answer

Answer: C. Digital transformation changes how the business works; a technology move alone does not.

S3Which challenge is most typical of an organization with old, hard-to-change systems?

  • ALegacy systems that are hard to modernize
  • BToo many choices of programming languages
  • CCustomers asking for faster digital service
  • DCompetitors that already use cloud technology
Show the answer

Answer: A. Legacy systems are a classic challenge; customer demand and competition are drivers.

S4A retailer needs more computing power during a holiday sale and less afterwards, paying only for what it uses. Which benefits apply?

  • AScalability and cost-effectiveness
  • BOpen source and open standards for any company
  • CAgentic AI and responsible AI
  • DData residency and sovereignty
Show the answer

Answer: A. Scaling up and down with pay-for-use pricing shows scalability and cost-effectiveness.

S5Which is a Google Cloud differentiator related to avoiding vendor lock-in?

  • AProprietary formats that only Google can read or write
  • BOpenness and interoperability with open standards
  • CA single mandatory operating system for all
  • DContracts that cover only one cloud provider
Show the answer

Answer: B. Openness and interoperability, including open source and open standards, give customers choice.

S6What is agentic AI?

  • AA database that stores customer agent records and logs
  • BA rule engine that never changes its decisions
  • CA network device that connects branch offices
  • DAI agents that reason, plan and act toward a goal
Show the answer

Answer: D. Agentic AI uses agents that reason, plan and take actions to reach goals.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is digital transformation?

Show the answer

Using digital technology to change how a business works and serves customers.

R2Name two benefits of the cloud.

Show the answer

For example scalability and cost-effectiveness.

R3Name a driver of transformation.

Show the answer

For example customer expectations or competition.

R4Name a challenge of transformation.

Show the answer

For example legacy systems, skills gaps or culture.

R5What does open standard mean?

Show the answer

A public specification that products follow to work together.

R6What is AI Hypercomputer?

Show the answer

Google Cloud's purpose-built infrastructure for AI.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Cloud resources over the internet, paid by use
Benefits scalability, cost, agility, flexibility, security, reach, insights, focus
Drivers / challenges customers and competition / legacy, skills, culture, security, silos
